business_summary: Hunan Sundy Science and Technology Co., Ltd provides analytical instruments and intelligent testing solutions for laboratories and industrial applications in China and internationally. The company offers bomb calorimeters; elemental analyzers, including carbon/hydrogen/nitrogen, infrared sulfur, coulomb sulfur, fluorine and chlorine, calorific-halogen, mercury, arsenic, and phosphorus analyzers, as well as spectrometers and combustion ion chromatography systems; and thermogravimetric analyzers comprising loss on ignition and moisture analyzers, intelligent muffle furnaces, and blast drying ovens. It also provides ash fusion and hardgrove grindability index testers; sample preparation equipment, such as quick dryers, hammer crushers and dividers, jaw and double roll crushers, humid coal hammer crushers, pulverizers, automatic dividers, and standard and environmental seive shakers; and auto sampling systems comprising all-pass integrated sampling and sample preparation systems. In addition, the company offers sample preparation auxiliary assembly products, such as online total moisture test systems, automatic sample storing and checking cabinets, and automatic sample transportation and dust extraction systems; stockpile-inventorying equipment, including portable, stationary laser, and unmanned aerial vehicle stockpile-inventorying systems; automatic robotic systems comprising robotic sample preparation and intelligent analysing systems; and fuel management and control products consisting of coal quality data management, and coal-yard dynamic management and control systems. Its products are used in environmental, food and feed, biomass fuel, and coal and coke applications. Hunan Sundy Science and Technology Co., Ltd was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Changsha, the People's Republic of China.
